commands.input_contract: See the CLI header. Credentials arrive on stdin and stay in RAM. Normal acceptance requires fresh independent same-tenant registry/ledger facts plus a separately sourced immutable rejection event. Baseline mode always fails and cannot establish acceptance.

independent_owner_context.verified_by: Human/Ops coordinator; read independently from registry, runtime bindings, telemetry and scoped historical journey

independent_owner_context.use: Coordination provenance only; not a fabricated complete acceptance input, a copy of Trading Pulse, or a permanent numeric snapshot. E must refresh the current witness within the CLI's 15-minute window.

excluded_attempt.outcome: Missing Chromium 1255 executable before any browser run; not measured UI failure evidence.
excluded_attempt.remediation: timeout 180s npx playwright install chromium completed exit 0; Chromium 1255 and headless shell installed, and the real-browser offline test subsequently passed.

harness_repairs: Relevant finite JSON bodies only, with 20-second body deadlines; never await open shell SSE before context close. Direct browser reads also have a 20-second abort deadline.
Narrow shell entry uses the existing Ctrl/Cmd+K command palette when the sidebar is hidden; no assumed mobile menu or direct URL substitution.

runtime_budget.schedule: On demand only; no recurring job, deployment dependency or pre-deploy gate added.
runtime_budget.bundle_limit: One sanitized summary plus at most one desktop and one narrow screenshot, including summary bytes. Oversized images are removed and the result fails; an oversized summary is replaced by a failed digest record.
runtime_budget.privacy: Private directories 0700 and files 0600. No credentials, cookie storage state, raw API bodies, traces, HAR or browser profiles retained. Chromium contexts and browser close before the command returns.

handoff_to_e: After A/B/D and this source PR merge, use the normal Dev Root process to establish one exact FE/BFF pair and verify deployment.json plus actual /bff/version before and after the probe.
